state.context: P9 exposes only maintained immutable HTML node, safe output, URL, attribute and tag handles plus HTMX target/swap handles. Authored raw markup, CSS, scripts and handlers are excluded. Text and attributes must escape through Bun.escapeHTML and addresses parse with URL. Validation needs ancestry facts for nested a/form rejection, separate head-only nodes, and original single-slash-relative URL classification for HTMX. Applications cannot import private runtime modules. Invalid proxy or accessor impostors must be rejected without executing traps. Legacy compatibility is not a requirement. Trusted output is an immutable rendered string behind its handle. Select storage/provenance machinery without changing source language.

representation.instructions: Select the internal design best matching the stated immutable authority and validation constraints.

criteria.weak: Allocate empty frozen handles and keep rendering plus fixed descendant/context facts in module-private WeakMaps; check identity membership first.
criteria.brand: Expose frozen objects carrying textual branding and HTML data, with sink checks based on reading that brand.
criteria.reparse: Represent values as plain markup strings and reconstruct trust through an additional HTML parser whenever consumed.
